title: Concurrent Link persistence writers can fork one accepted revision
description: Python LinkLayer writes the signed state slot and internal digest anchor before advancing the independent revision CAS. Two instances loaded at revision 1 can both write divergent revision 2; winner A advances external CAS, stale B overwrites the shared revision-2 slot/anchor then loses CAS and disables. Restart sees external revision 2 and accepts B's state, losing A's replay floor. Add exclusive persistence ownership or a recoverable prepare/commit protocol atomically binding revision and digest so losers cannot overwrite committed state. Test divergent replay/session/pin state and all interleavings; restart must retain the CAS winner and reject same-revision forks.
